method.purpose: Small quality advantages should accumulate without dominating every category. Earlier 90% versus 65–70% accuracy targets are superseded.
method.conditions: Same player templates, roles, hidden tendencies and balanced tactics. One side has +3 base ability points. Lower XIs average 75.17 and 82.16; higher XIs average 78.16 and 85.13. Runtime badge minima apply normally. Six seeds per band, 3-/5-minute formats; both orientations in initial checks and alternating orientation in validation. No AI coaching.
method.sample: 20 initial mirrored cases (16 unequal, 4 equal), 16 fresh-seed close cases, and 8 existing real-club S–B/S–C pairs. Initial seeds and match lengths are correlated; this is a descriptive check, not a population win-rate estimate.
method.baselineReuse: Real-club baseline outputs are reused from the exact v40 engine and unchanged fixtures. Newly simulated close fixtures use a frozen copy of that version.
method.unchanged: No forced wins, goals, possession or pass-completion quotas. Catalog, overalls, tier thresholds, badge counts, tactical settings, shot frequency, match durations and base movement coefficients are unchanged.

changes.curve: clamp(1 + (75 - ability) × 0.012 × influence, 0.72, 1.28); replaces exponential error reduction.
changes.other: Reduced extra pass-disguise, pressure-resistance and decision-noise bonuses. Retains goal-side coverage, collection and goalkeeper fixes.
changes.savedSettings: Version 8 upgrades only unchanged earlier device defaults; custom values and explicit match settings retain their chosen numbers.
